```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution X) : R.cochainComplex.IsKProjective := by
  apply CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective
  · exact 0
  · exact CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.instIsStrictlyLECochainComplexOfNatInt R
  · intro n
    exact CategoryTheory.Projective.resolution_proj R n
  · intro n
    exact (CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.cochainComplexXIso.congr_simp R n 0 rfl).symm
```
